semantic_assessment: Every retained id, kind, invariant, source anchor, configuration, disposition and other semantic field is identical to its historical preimage. Only the exact approved fresh evidence and independent review change. The 191 non-runtime classifications are not runtime passes. Both original sources and generated equivalent source hashes were independently replayed.

Applicability is exactly624 records in both configurations records,83 upstream-test-only records andone default-only omission witness, yielding16,824 context associations. GENGC REVIEWED-BLOCK-0007 certifies its default early return only; the whole-file manual audit covers both configurations. No instrumented retained process contains a T omission, and all208processes assert reduction flags absent.

Events (149 records): unchanged C/Ada executions preserve all reviewed metamethod/callback sections, instrumented userdata behavior, stream dependency and the explicit returned value 12 wrapper assertion. Every instrumented Ada run records one real managed refusal in the concat failure path. Both plus markers, terminal OK and the return witness occur in source order.

GC (123 records): every process reaches weak graphs, long strings, self-referenced threads, emergency collection, late finalizer-stack tests and the closing-state marker after OK. Every instrumented Ada process records 202 actual refusals,10 expected shutdown finalizer warnings, shutdown_complete=true and zero live allocator bytes/blocks. Native ltests refusal occurs below the outer telemetry wrapper and is not incorrectly inferred from its zero outer refusal count.

The five Ada-equivalent GC records retain the four approved source-span replacements: measure/reclaim both 4 MiB payloads without imposing C table capacity; observe the actual gray child of a black Ada capture cell while collecting the weak coroutine and preserving its final value 30; perform 200 real measured-headroom allocations with at least 199 refusals/recoveries. Original C execution and named physical Ada regressions remain required and were replayed. Neither compiler retirement nor scalar-write deferral weakens captured/heap barriers or these invariants.

GENGC (32 records): unchanged actual processes exercise age/barrier transitions and minor/major work. All seven instrumented contexts reach userdata evolution, the stop-the-world stepsize block, parameter coding and mode restoration; default omission evidence never certifies that tail. Original assertions remain enabled.

Files (404 records): actual IO setup, flush, large-file, popen/execute and date/version completion are present in every context; all seven instrumented contexts also reach failed-write. Windows/macOS equivalents remain explicitly labelled and source-bound, while Linux retains unchanged execution. Partial IO, exact child status ordering, native failing streams and platform calendar boundaries retain their independently approved counterparts. Ada children are balanced with eight Windows records,six default POSIX records andseven instrumented POSIX records; native C records remain four Windows,two default POSIX andthree instrumented POSIX because its typed-exit children bypass main-return telemetry.

Actual native branch facts agree between C/Ada for all 26 contexts: C int 4/Lua integer 8 and boolean isdst. Windows rejects time 2^40/year 4000 as unrepresentable; POSIX supports and roundtrips both. Source-bound native counterparts execute exact field overflow/recovery and year4000 input, omitted/false/true DST normalization and removal of isdst preserving the instant. Eight-byte C-int and nil-output-DST alternatives are reviewed reference conditions, never reported as executed bodies. macOS nested-shell and last-second calendar differences retain their distinct native diagnostics and approved replacements.

All 26 warning indices and170 named probes were replayed, including normal/shutdown rejection, explicit off and instrumented stored-warning consumption. Fresh Linux/macOS captures preserve exact warning payloads and source chunk identities; Linux exit 1 conversion and macOS bounded GNAT transport are accepted only through the source-linked exact verifier. Passing controls have clean stderr. No arbitrary diagnostic normalization was introduced.

Official named evidence replay checks the 100 C/94 AUnit source-hashed case mapping, retaining the 35 collector witnesses and the added compiler/scalar regressions, and reconciles actual Ada runtime and separate native oracle identities against the file reports. The new regression cases supplement unchanged retained assertions; none replaces a source obligation.

All 708 projection hashes were recomputed independently with recursive-key-sorted compact UTF-8 JSON and array order preserved. Each required context has the exact current C/Ada report identities, current revision, case id and permanent review fragment. No prior failed/partial candidate or coarse enclosing PASS grants current applicability.
